the-gates-of-kordavos.where: The party waits in the line outside the gate of Kordavos, two groups back from the sergeant's table.

the-front-of-the-line.where: The party stands at the front of the line at Garlan's checkpoint outside the gate of Kordavos.

the-harvest-festival.where: The party has come up the street from the gate into the festival square.

clan-conflict.where: At the south end of the festival square, where the street from the gate opens into it, Barok Redbeard and Larya Halloway face each other with two of their people behind each. Onlookers have drawn back into a ring around them. The party stands at the front of the crowd on the square's side.

the-dragonbone-inn.where: Evening in the common room of the Dragonbone Inn: a great stone hearth with a dragon's skull over the mantel, a bard by the fire, the bar along the back wall, stairs up to the rooms, a dark corner where two hooded strangers sit. Bram has brought the party to the corner table by the street windows. A scarred dockworker and a spectacled scholar watch them from a barrel by the bar.

an-unsolicited-opportunity.where: Late evening in the Dragonbone Inn's common room. Beric and Eamon stand at the party's corner table by the street windows. Bram is at the bar. A doorway at the bar's east end leads to a dim backroom with a sturdy table and mismatched chairs.

morning-at-the-dragonbone.where: Early morning sun falls through the street windows of the Dragonbone Inn's common room. The fire is banked and the room nearly empty, an old farmer at breakfast. The party is at a table under the windows, Bram in front of the bar.

the-old-grand-library.where: Midday in the great hall of the Old Grand Library: bookcases two storeys high with a gallery round them, saints in stained glass, a painted vault and a dome over the crossing, a red rug under it, lecterns down the sides. The party stands just inside the entrance. Sister Danica has come to them from beside a reading table where a young acolyte writes. At the far end a red door under a balcony leads to the private archives, where the archivist keeps out of sight by a locked glass cabinet.

the-silver-serpent-tavern.where: Daytime in the Silver Serpent, a long, dim dockside tavern of tarred timber, smoky and crowded with sailors, smugglers and dockhands. Its far end is a great arch open on the foggy quay. A sea map is carved into the west wall, and a silver sea serpent hangs over the bar on the east side, where Harron wipes glasses before shelves of bottles and sea-curios. The party stands just inside the street door. Three dockworkers drink at the table under the sea map, the burly one leaning back to watch them.

arrival-at-the-docks.where: Golden late afternoon on the Kordavos docks: a broad cobbled quay along the harbour, the tall elven ship Star of Faelendar moored at it with a gangway to her deck, a treadwheel crane and stacks of cargo beside her, stone warehouses with arcades and stalls along the back of the quay, and Warehouse 14, a timber shed, in the shadowed corner at its west end. The party has come along the quay. Ahead by the cargo stacks, a grizzled dockworker in a leather apron has set down a crate and eyes them, a huge tattooed dockworker and a dock hand with a pipe beside him.

mystery-cargo.where: Warehouse 14, a timber storage shed in the shadowed west corner of the Kordavos quay, its double doors open on stacks of crates, a row of barrels, bales of silk, a small lockbox on a crate, and against the back wall a great iron-banded crate hung with chain. A tall scarred man and three hired blades in work clothes stand at the doors with short swords drawn. The party faces them from the quay.

the-beast-escapes.where: The Kordavos quay in chaos: the quay is strewn with smashed crates and loose planks, the Star of Faelendar's main course hangs torn, and her cargo hatch amidships has burst open on the iron cage below, its bars eaten through. The forest drake has come off the ship onto the quay beside the gangway, wings raised, roaring. A tall woman in black leather armour stands at the gangway's end with a curved blade drawn. The party has run out along the quay from Warehouse 14.

the-aftermath.where: The dust settling on the Kordavos quay: the quay is strewn with smashed crates and loose planks, the Star of Faelendar's main course hangs torn, and her cargo hatch amidships has burst open on the iron cage below, its bars eaten through. Lady Astrid stands with the party near the gangway. Petra calls from the ship's deck beside the burst hatch.

an-invitation.where: The Kordavos quay after the drake: the quay is strewn with smashed crates and loose planks, the Star of Faelendar's main course hangs torn, and her cargo hatch amidships has burst open on the iron cage below, its bars eaten through. Lady Astrid faces the party near the gangway with a sealed invitation.

welcome-to-the-lower-districts.where: A narrow street in Kordavos's Lower Districts at the grey end of the day: tall leaning timber tenements jut over wet cobbles, washing strung between them, lanterns lit on brackets, a crowd of hooded folk hurrying both ways. A house is built across the street further up, its archway the way on, and a side alley turns off to the west. The party has come up from the docks and stands near the street's lower end. A fiddler plays by a shop window, a hooded woman hurries past, and a trinket-seller watches from a doorway.

beset-by-street-urchins.where: The crowded street in the Lower Districts by the mouth of a side alley, the crowd thick around the party. Halfling urchins weave among them: a red-haired girl skips right up to the heroes, a wide-eyed boy slips past behind them, two more giggle a few steps off. A fiddler plays by a cart against the wall. The side alley to the west is the urchins' way out.

finding-the-black-market.where: A narrow side alley off the Lower Districts' street as the light fades: damp stone ground floors, timber storeys leaning close overhead, washing strung across, crates and barrels against the walls, a lantern here and there. The party stands a few paces in from the street. At their feet a paving stone has a small crooked dagger cut into it, and further in a stone over a doorway bears a snake coiled round a crescent moon. A trinket-seller lounges near the end, where a dark archway leads to a shut gate, and a hooded woman comes from it.

the-entrance-to-the-black-market.where: Nightfall in a narrow court between two crumbling buildings. Its north end is an old stone wall with an arched doorway hung with heavy ochre curtains, half drawn, darkness and a glimmer of lamps beyond. Planked-up doors and a lantern either side. The party stands in the court a few paces back. A huge hooded guard stands before the curtain, arms crossed, a long dagger in his belt.

labyrinthine-stalls.where: Inside the Black Market at night: a narrow lane of stalls and tents between leaning houses, roofed with patched canvas and strung with lanterns, braziers smoking, cloaked buyers drifting through. The party stands just inside the curtain. At the first stall on the right a grizzled dealer leans over a counter heaped with gold and gems; a dwarf weapon dealer shows a dagger at her rack of blades on the left; a scarred young woman saunters past. A side lane turns east to a peddler's tent of curiosities, another turns west to a shadowy stall of elven goods. At the far end of the lane, a curtained door between braziers leads to the auction house.

the-auction-begins.where: Deeper in the Black Market, the auction house: a candlelit horseshoe hall of old stone with a gallery of standing buyers round it, rows of velvet chairs facing a stone lectern and a half-round stage. The masked auctioneer stands at the lectern with a jewelled dagger, his assistant beside him; masked bidders fill the seats. Near the back by the side exit a hooded man in a velvet chair watches, a well-dressed man at his shoulder and two guards behind. The party stands at the back of the hall by the entrance.

a-relic-of-old-valkara.where: Deeper in the Black Market, the auction house: a candlelit horseshoe hall of old stone with a gallery of standing buyers round it, rows of velvet chairs facing a stone lectern and a half-round stage. The relic map of Old Valkara lies open on the lectern before the auctioneer. Silverhand's representative has stepped into the east aisle to bid while Silverhand watches from his seat near the side exit, his guards behind him. The party stands at the back of the hall by the entrance.

the-winning-bid.where: Deeper in the Black Market, the auction house: a candlelit horseshoe hall of old stone with a gallery of standing buyers round it, rows of velvet chairs facing a stone lectern and a half-round stage. The map is sold and gone from the lectern. Silverhand's representative waits at the side exit with the map case; Silverhand has risen and makes for it, his two guards flanking him. The party stands at the back of the hall by the entrance.

shadowing-silverhand.where: Late evening in the old lanes of Kordavos: a narrow cobbled street of leaning timber houses under a low moon, mist between them, lanterns on brackets. The party stands at the near end. Some twenty paces ahead Silverhand walks away up the street with his representative and Varchk a step behind; Kaeleth lingers at the corner of the crossing further on, watching the way they came. A side alley turns off east before the crossing. Beyond the crossing the street runs under an archway in a house built across it.

the-hideout.where: Night on the waterfront, thick sea mist: a lane of old stone houses runs down to a quay over the harbour. Near the water on the east side stands the abandoned warehouse, weathered boards over a stone ground storey, its windows boarded, its rusted iron door hanging open under a red lantern. Varchk and Kaeleth keep the door. Silverhand crosses the lane toward it. The party watches from the shadows on the west side, up the lane. Crates and barrels are heaped along the warehouse wall toward the quay.

entry-to-the-ball.where: Evening at the Blackthorn mansion in the Asterian Quarter: a long front of dressed stone with lit windows and spired corner towers, a portico at the head of a grand staircase. The party has come in through the wrought-iron gates across the cobbled court and stands at the foot of the stair among masked guests. Barok and another guard in black armour with the Blackthorn crest stand at its foot, checking each guest.

inside-the-ball.where: The masquerade ball: a long hall of marble columns under gilded arches, a painted barrel vault, three great chandeliers, red velvet at the tall windows, banquet tables and a gem display in the west aisle. Masked guests in lavish costumes talk in pairs across the floor. At the far end a stage hung with the house's banners and red drapes, a curtained cage on its west half. Glazed doors in the east wall stand open onto a moonlit balcony. The party has just come in by the grand doors.

the-blackthorns.where: The middle of the ballroom floor among masked guests, under the chandeliers. Lady Astrid Blackthorn, in a gold mask and a black gown with a golden wrap, has crossed the floor to the party; Lord Thaddeus holds court a few paces off.

the-lady-and-the-bishop.where: The ballroom by the east colonnade, near a tall curtained window. Seraphina Valtor, white-haired in ivory and green with a gilt mask, and Bishop Nicolai in a silver full mask and gold headdress have come to the party through the crowd.

a-distraction.where: The ballroom with every eye on the floor. Lady Astrid stands at the foot of the stage addressing the guests; the elf bard Aelindor comes in by the grand doors and plays his lyre in the middle of the floor. The party stands in the crowd on the west side, near the colonnade and the way out of the hall.

the-speech.where: Lord Thaddeus stands on the stage at the far end of the ballroom, the crowd gathered below. The curtain on the stage's west half is drawn back: the forest drake glares from a great iron cage. Eamon stands in the crowd. The party is among the guests in front of the stage.

death-to-the-murderer.where: Lord Thaddeus on the stage, the caged drake beside him, the crowd's eyes on it. A hooded figure waits at the foot of the stage close to him. Glazed doors in the east wall open onto the balcony. The party is in the crowd in front of the stage.

through-the-halls.where: A dim, high stair hall away from the ball. At its far end a grand stair climbs in two flights to a gallery, up to the family's floors, under a tall moonlit window; candle stands burn at the foot of each flight. By the near wall on the right, narrow steps go down through an arch into the dark, toward the cellars. The party stands in the middle of the hall.

the-rangers-quarters.where: The family's upper floor: a long corridor of damask over dark panelling, portraits in gilt frames, tapestries of the Asterian eagle, a runner down the middle. At its end a heavy double door carved with branches, twisted boughs framing it, candle sconces either side. No one else is on this floor. The party stands before the door.

the-lavish-corridor.where: The family's upper floor, deep in the house: a long corridor of portraits, tapestries, candelabra and crystal chandeliers. Two Blackthorn guards stand at ease before the great carved door of Thaddeus's chambers in the east wall, chatting. The party is a few paces up the corridor.

thaddeus-blackthorns-private-chambers.where: Thaddeus Blackthorn's study: dark panelling, a mahogany desk heaped with ledgers and maps before a tall window on moonlit Kordavos, velvet curtains half drawn. Shelves of scrolls along the west wall, a glass cabinet of trinkets in the corner, a hearth on the east wall with an ornate sword over it, and a tapestry hiding a second door. The party has just come in by the door.

the-chase.where: The ballroom's balcony on the mansion's east wing, high over the walled garden in the moonlight. A rope hangs from the balustrade to the ground. Below, among flower beds and gravel paths, the hooded figure makes for an old drain grate under the ivy on the east wall. The party stands at the balustrade.

the-hunt-for-the-assassin.where: The mansion's walled garden by moonlight: gravel paths, flower beds, ivy thick on the east wall. By the wall an old drain grate is set in the paving, runes faintly glowing on its frame. Lady Astrid, now in ranger's leathers, has led the party here; Eamon kneels at the grate working on its seal; two Blackthorn guards hold lanterns.

face-to-face-with-silverhand.where: A cramped, low back room in the abandoned warehouse: board walls, beams overhead, crates and sacks of smuggled goods stacked along every wall. A long weathered table runs down the middle with empty chairs either side. Silverhand sits in a high-backed chair at its far end behind a single candle and an uncorked bottle of Hammerdeep whiskey, his silver gauntlet on the table. Varchk stands behind him. The party has just come in by the door at the near end.

the-wine-cellar.where: Below the Blackthorn mansion: a long stone barrel vault reached by a stair from the halls above. Racks of dusty bottles line both walls, and rows of casks lie before them with their heads to the aisle, some stacked two high, room to hide behind them. Two candle chandeliers hang over the aisle. At the far end, beyond a small tasting table, stands a sturdier rack of newer, paler wood against the wall. The party stands in the middle of the aisle. The sommelier and a servant come down the stair when they arrive.

into-the-catacombs.where: Deep under Kordavos: a long tunnel of old laid stone, torches on its walls, runs down into a cave chamber held up by four rough stone pillars. Four hooded Covenant agents are setting powder kegs against the pillars, and a long fuse snakes across the floor from keg to keg to a cultist by the far tunnel mouth. The party stands in the tunnel just before the chamber with Lady Astrid and Eamon at its front; Astrid's soldiers come behind. The tunnel goes on beyond the chamber into the dark.

through-the-labyrinth.where: A rough-hewn cave under the city where the tunnel splits into two forks of dripping stone, a cold mist drifting out of them. Crystal-set runes glow faintly blue in the walls. The party stands in the cave; Eamon studies the runes on the east wall while Lady Astrid looks down the left-hand fork. The right fork runs off into darkness; the left bends twice and ends at a blank, seamless wall.

the-sealed-door.where: At the end of the left-hand tunnel the seamless wall has become a massive black iron door in a carved stone frame, glowing sigils pulsing on its face, frost on the floor before it. Eamon stands at the door; Lady Astrid is a step behind with her sword drawn. The party stands in the tunnel behind them.

big-empty.where: Beyond the iron door, a vast cavern whose roof is lost in the dark, its floor deep in fine grey dust. A single narrow archway glows blue at the far end. Lady Astrid has stepped out into the middle of the hall; Eamon stays back by the door with the party just inside it. The ancient dead lie hidden under the dust until they rise.

forgotten-temple.where: Through the narrow archway, a hidden cathedral of Old Valkara: walls of white marble glowing with a faint inner starlight, pillars carved as ancient oaks branching up into a vault painted with the constellations of a lost sky. At its centre, on a stepped dais in a ring of silver runes, an empty altar, the air above it rippling. Shadows lie behind the altar. The party has just come through the archway with Lady Astrid and Eamon.

final-confrontation.where: The hidden cathedral under its vault of stars, before the empty altar in its ring of silver runes. Joran Antonov, in the robes of the Covenant with the hood thrown back, has stepped out from the shadows behind the altar and stands before it, the Key of Ilmarin raised. The party faces him across the nave, Lady Astrid on their left with her sword, Eamon on their right.

the-ambush.where: Late night in the narrow lanes on the way back to the Dragonbone Inn. Two flat-roofed stone houses stand over the street, taller than the timber houses round them. A hooded archer stands at the parapet of each, one on the west roof beside the party and one on the east roof further up the street. An arrow is stuck in the door of the west house beside the party, another in the wall ahead. The party is in the street between the two houses, heading back toward the inn.

the-new-dawn.where: Dawn in the great square of Kordavos, bells ringing, the old green banners of Valkara hung from every house. At the head of the square stands the great stone house with a balcony over its door: Joran Antonov stands on it with the Key of Ilmarin raised, Seraphina Valtor at his shoulder. The square below is full of Valkarans. The party stands among them in the middle of the square.

the-dust-settles.where: The Old Grand Library, its bookcases two storeys high under the painted vault. At the reading table near the entrance Bishop Nicolai presides over the truce talks; Seraphina Valtor and Lady Astrid Blackthorn sit across the table from each other, and Sister Danica stands by. The party watches from under the dome.

vengeance-of-the-blackthorn.where: Midday in the great square of Kordavos under black banners. Thaddeus Blackthorn's coffin lies on a draped bier before the great stone house, tall candles at its corners. Asterian soldiers line an aisle from the bier back to the street, knights stand before the house, and the city crowds in behind them. Lady Astrid stands at the coffin's foot facing the square. The party stands in the aisle.
